title: The Demon Sovereign's Bloodline
summary: The monumental 100th chapter milestone. Ha-Jun Kang achieves ultimate planetary harmony, consecrating the Demon Sovereign Bloodline as the eternal covenant of peace across Earth and the cosmos.

panels.shot: grand title splash: DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — CHAPTER 100
panels.action: A breathtaking full-bleed splash panel: golden calligraphy blazing across a starfield: 'CHAPTER 100 — THE DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE'.

dialogue.text: ONE HUNDRED CHAPTERS. THREE THOUSAND PANELS. AN ETERNAL SAGA.

panels.prose_en: Golden calligraphy blazing across a starfield: 'CHAPTER 100 — THE DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE'.
panels.prose_hi: Ek taare ke kshetra mein chamakti hui sunhari sulekh: 'adhyay 100 - danav samprabhu ki raktarekha'.

panels.shot: sunrise breaking over seoul: the rain stopping as golden dawn floods the city
panels.action: The gentle rain clears; the golden morning sun rises over Namsan Tower and the Han River, washing the world in amber.
panels.prose_en: The gentle rain clears; the golden morning sun rises over Namsan Tower and the Han River, washing the world in amber.
panels.prose_hi: Halki baarish saaf ho jaati hai; subah ka sunhara suraj namson tower aur haan nadi par ugta hai, jo duniya ko ambar mein dho deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking out onto the open observation deck breathing the clean fresh air
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps into the clean morning air, breathing deep; his dark fringe catches the morning light.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: A brand new day. And the world is peaceful.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps into the clean morning air, breathing deep; his dark fringe catches the morning light.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun subah ki saaf hawa mein gahri sans lete hue kadam rakhta hai; uska andhera kinara subah ki roshni ko pakad leta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping beside him leaning on the railing with his coffee
panels.action: Tae-Jun leans beside him, watching the sun illuminate their city: 'You did it, Ha-Jun. You really did it.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Hamari family ka lamba safar poora hua.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun leans beside him, watching the sun illuminate their city: 'You did it, Ha-Jun. You really did it.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun uske bagal mein jhuk jata hai, suraj ko apne shahar ko roshan karte hue dekhta hai: 'tumne yah kiya, ha-jun. aapne sachmuch yah kiya.'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at his right hand: the sovereign crest glowing with gentle warmth
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at his palm: the purple crest of the Sovereign pulses like a warm heartbeat, tamed and peaceful.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bloodline ab curse nahi hai. It's a bridge.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at his palm: the purple crest of the Sovereign pulses like a warm heartbeat, tamed and peaceful.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni hatheli ko dekhta hai: samprabhu ki baingani shikha ek garm dil ki dhadkan ki tarah, niyantrit aur shantipurna hai.

panels.shot: kuro perching on ha-jun shoulder greeting the morning sun with a royal caw
panels.action: Kuro spreads his dark wings, greeting the morning sun with a clear, triumphant caw that echoes across the valley.
panels.prose_en: Kuro spreads his dark wings, greeting the morning sun with a clear, triumphant caw that echoes across the valley.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne kale pankh failakar, spasht, vijayi con-con ke saath subah ke suraj ka swagat karta hai, jo puri ghati mein goonjati hai.

panels.shot: down below: saint mirren international university gates opening for the new day
panels.action: At Saint Mirren, the grand iron gates swing open; students of all races and origins enter together under cherry blossoms.
panels.prose_en: At Saint Mirren, the grand iron gates swing open; students of all races and origins enter together under cherry blossoms.
panels.prose_hi: Sent miren men, bhavya lohe ke dwar khule han; sabhi jaatiyon aur moolon ke chhatra cherry blossom ke neeche ek saath pravesh karte han.

panels.shot: in the classroom: student desks bathed in clean, bright morning sunlight
panels.action: The empty classroom from Chapter 84 is bathed in serene, peaceful sunlight, waiting for students.
panels.prose_en: The empty classroom from Chapter 84 is bathed in serene, peaceful sunlight, waiting for students.
panels.prose_hi: Adhyay 84 ki khali kaksha shant, shantipurna dhoop se nahakar chhatron ki pratiksha kar rahi hai.

panels.shot: apartment 402: freshly painted white walls and the graduation photo on the mantelpiece
panels.action: Inside the renovated Kang apartment: the new polaroid photo rests beside their parents' memorial in warm morning light.
panels.prose_en: Inside the renovated Kang apartment: the new polaroid photo rests beside their parents' memorial in warm morning light.
panels.prose_hi: Punarnirmit kang apartment ke ander: naya poleroid photo subah ki garm roshni mein unke mata-pita ke smarak ke bagal mein rakha gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun pulling his student academy blazer onto his shoulders
panels.action: Ha-Jun slips on his navy academy uniform blazer, fastening the silver buttons with a relaxed smile.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slips on his navy academy uniform blazer, fastening the silver buttons with a relaxed smile.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apni nausena akadami ki vardi ka blazer pahan liya aur ek aaramdayak muskan ke saath chandi ke button bandhe.

panels.shot: tae-jun adjusting ha-jun tie with affectionate elder brother care
panels.action: Tae-Jun straightens Ha-Jun's navy tie: 'Still can't tie a Windsor knot properly, can you?'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Let your big brother fix your tie.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun straightens Ha-Jun's navy tie: 'Still can't tie a Windsor knot properly, can you?'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne ha-jun ki navy tie ko sidha kiya: 'abhi bhi windsor gaanth ko theek se nahin baandh sakte, kya aap aisa kar sakte han?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun laughing sheepishly: 'some things never change, hyung'
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles warmly: 'Some things should never change.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuch cheezein aisi hi achhi lagti hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles warmly: 'Some things should never change.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun garmjoshi se muskurate han: 'kuchh chijen kabhi nahin badalani chahiye.'

panels.shot: min-jae waving from the observatory exit: 'the cable car is waiting, boys!'
panels.action: Min-Jae waves from the cable car terminal: 'Hurry up! We're riding down together!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Cable car departs in two minutes!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae waves from the cable car terminal: 'Hurry up! We're riding down together!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je cable car terminal se tarangen: 'jaldi karo! hum ek saath neeche sawari kar rahe han!

panels.shot: captain baek saluting with a wide grin stepping into the cabin
panels.action: General Baek enters the cable car cabin, chuckling: 'Shotgun on the window seat!'
panels.prose_en: General Baek enters the cable car cabin, chuckling: 'Shotgun on the window seat!'.
panels.prose_hi: Janaral bak cable car cabin mein pravesh karte hue hanste hue kahte han: 'khidki ki seat par shotgan!'.

panels.shot: the four companions and kuro boarding the cable car descending into the city
panels.action: The red cable car glides down the mountain cable over pine trees, carrying the family toward the city streets.
panels.prose_en: The red cable car glides down the mountain cable over pine trees, carrying the family toward the city streets.
panels.prose_hi: Lal cable car cheed ke pedon ke upar se pahadi cable ke neeche sarakti hui parivar ko shahar ki sadkon ki or le jaati hai.

panels.shot: inside the car: laughing, taking selfies, and pointing at the landmarks
panels.action: Inside the glass cabin: Min-Jae snaps funny selfies with Ha-Jun, while Kuro investigates Baek's shiny coat buttons.
panels.prose_en: Inside the glass cabin: Min-Jae snaps funny selfies with Ha-Jun, while Kuro investigates Baek's shiny coat buttons.
panels.prose_hi: Kaanch ke cabin ke ander: min-je ne ha-jun ke saath majedar selfie khinchi, jabki kuro ne bake ke chamakdar coat ke batanon ki jaanch ki.

panels.shot: ha-jun making a goofy peace sign pose sticking his tongue out
panels.action: Ha-Jun flashes a goofy two-finger peace sign with his tongue out, laughing like any ordinary 20-year-old college boy.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flashes a goofy two-finger peace sign with his tongue out, laughing like any ordinary 20-year-old college boy.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kisi bhi samanya 20 varshiya college ladke ki tarah hanste hue, apni jeebh bahar nikalkar do ungaliyon wala shanti chinh dikhata hai.

panels.shot: cable car arriving at the base terminal in bustling downtown seoul
panels.action: The car docks at the busy mountain base terminal; commuters, children with backpacks, and vendors bustle around.
panels.prose_en: The car docks at the busy mountain base terminal; commuters, children with backpacks, and vendors bustle around.
panels.prose_hi: Kar vyast parvatiya base terminal par rukti hai; yatri, backpack wale bacche aur vikreta charon or halchal karte han.

panels.shot: the group walking out into the sunlit seoul streets among thousands of citizens
panels.action: The group walks down the tree-lined sidewalk, blending seamlessly into the flow of ordinary human life.

dialogue.text: A God who chose to walk as a mortal among his people.

panels.prose_en: The group walks down the tree-lined sidewalk, blending seamlessly into the flow of ordinary human life.
panels.prose_hi: Samuh pedon se ghire footpath par chalta hai aur samanya manav jeevan ke pravah mein sahajta se ghulmil jata hai.

panels.shot: a small child dropping an ice cream cone on the sidewalk
panels.action: A five-year-old girl trips, her ice cream scoop tumbling toward the concrete sidewalk.
panels.prose_en: A five-year-old girl trips, her ice cream scoop tumbling toward the concrete sidewalk.
panels.prose_hi: Ek paanch saal ki ladki yatra kar rahi hai, uska icecream scoop concrete ke footpath ki or gir raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun catching the falling ice cream with a subtle flick of telekinetic mana
panels.action: Ha-Jun casually catches the ice cream scoop mid-air with an invisible puff of mana, placing it safely back on her cone.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun casually catches the ice cream scoop mid-air with an invisible puff of mana, placing it safely back on her cone.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne man ki adrishya kash ke saath hawa mein icecream scoop ko laparvahi se pakad liya aur surakshit roop se wapas apne kon par rakh diya.

panels.shot: ha-jun kneeling handing the cone back with a warm wink to the girl
panels.action: Ha-Jun winks at the little girl: 'Careful there, little one. Enjoy your breakfast!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun winks at the little girl: 'Careful there, little one. Enjoy your breakfast!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne chhoti ladki ki or aankh maarte hue kaha: 'savdhan raho, chhoti bacchi. apne nashte ka anand len!'

panels.shot: the child mother bowing in gratitude as the little girl giggles happily
panels.action: The mother bows with a warm smile: 'Thank you, young man!' Ha-Jun waves back cheerfully.
panels.prose_en: The mother bows with a warm smile: 'Thank you, young man!' Ha-Jun waves back cheerfully.
panels.prose_hi: Maa garm muskan ke saath jhukti hai: 'dhanyavad, jawan aadmi!' ha-jun khushi se wapas lautata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun watching with a deep, proud smile walking beside him
panels.action: Tae-Jun bumps Ha-Jun's shoulder gently: 'You're a natural at this, you know.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein bohot achhe insaan ban gaye ho.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun bumps Ha-Jun's shoulder gently: 'You're a natural at this, you know.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne ha-jun ke kandhe ko dheere se thapthpaya: 'aap isme swabhavik han, aap jaante han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at the saint mirren university clocktower in the distance
panels.action: Ahead through the golden trees, the clocktower of Saint Mirren University chimes eight o'clock.
panels.prose_en: Ahead through the golden trees, the clocktower of Saint Mirren University chimes eight o'clock.
panels.prose_hi: Sunahre pedon ke beech se aage, sent miren vishwavidyalaya ka ghantaghar aath baje ki ghanti bajata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun, tae-jun, and min-jae jogging together toward the campus gates
panels.action: The three young men jog toward the university archway, wind whipping their hair, backpacks bouncing happily.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Last one to the lecture hall buys lunch!!

panels.prose_en: The three young men jog toward the university archway, wind whipping their hair, backpacks bouncing happily.
panels.prose_hi: Teenon yuvak vishwavidyalaya ke pravesh dwar ki or daud rahe han, hawa unke baalon ko chhoo rahi hai, unke backpack khushi se uchhal rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun sprinting ahead with an effortless burst of speed laughing
panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs, accelerating ahead: 'You're buying lunch today, Min-Jae!!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs, accelerating ahead: 'You're buying lunch today, Min-Jae!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hansta hai, teji se aage badhta hai: 'aap aaj dopahar ka bhojan kharid rahe han, min-je!!'.

panels.shot: kuro flying overhead in the azure sky his violet feathers catching golden light
panels.action: High in the azure heavens, Kuro soars in majestic circles, watching his family run with joy.

dialogue.text: No chains. No fear. Only the open sky.

panels.prose_en: High in the azure heavens, Kuro soars in majestic circles, watching his family run with joy.
panels.prose_hi: Nile aakash mein unche, kuro rajsi mandaliyon mein udta hai, apne parivar ko khushi se daudte hue dekhta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning his head back mid-stride looking directly at the reader with a radiant smile
panels.action: Ha-Jun glances over his shoulder, looking straight into the reader's eyes with a breathtaking, radiant, thankful smile.

dialogue.text: Thank you for walking this road with me.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun glances over his shoulder, looking straight into the reader's eyes with a breathtaking, radiant, thankful smile.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne kandhe par nazar dalta hai, ek lubhavni, ujjwal, aabhari muskan ke saath sidhe pathak ki aankhon mein dekhta hai.

panels.shot: the final grand panel: the three friends running through the golden gates into the sunrise
panels.action: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, and Min-Jae run through the grand neoclassical gates into the blazing golden sunrise, with Kuro soaring above them into eternity!

dialogue.text: DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — COMPLETE. 100 CHAPTERS. 3,000 PANELS. THE SAGA IS FINISHED IN ETERNAL GLORY.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, and Min-Jae run through the grand neoclassical gates into the blazing golden sunrise, with Kuro soaring above them into eternity!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun, taaye-jun, aur min-je bhavya navashastriy dwaron se hokar dhadhakte sunhare suryoday ki or daudte han, kuro unke upar anant kaal tak udta hai!
